title: Updated Desired Deployment
description: A signed config document selecting release endpoints, exact application/provider targets, the pinned release-repository root, and the node's managed runtime policy. Mirrors `RepositoryAssignment` in updated-contracts, which is deny_unknown_fields.

deployment.description: Bounded deployment identity copied into status and telemetry: 1-128 characters of lowercase ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore, or dash, beginning and ending with a letter or digit. Uppercase is refused so one identity cannot become two on a case-folding filesystem, and reserved Windows device stems (con, prn, aux, nul, com1-9, lpt1-9), alone or with an extension, are excluded.

metadataUrl.description: HTTPS base URL of the release repository's TUF metadata, ending in `/`; a `file://` URL or absolute local path is accepted only for offline repositories. Userinfo, query, and fragment are forbidden.

targetsUrl.description: Base URL of the release repository's TUF targets under the same HTTPS/offline rules as `metadataUrl`.

coldInstallFallback.description: Only when no release has ever been installed, allow descent through signed repository history if the exact assigned head is unusable. This is never an update or rollback policy.

releaseRoot.description: The pinned TUF root metadata of the release repository, embedded verbatim as a signed `{signed, signatures}` envelope. Validation requires a JSON object.

product.description: The bounded product identity used as a target-layout and directory segment: 1-128 characters of lowercase ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore, or dash, beginning and ending with a letter or digit. Uppercase and reserved Windows device stems are excluded, because this value becomes a directory name.

channel.description: The bounded TUF target-layout segment selecting a release channel.

installRoot.description: Absolute install root on the node.

input_selection.description: A non-secret descriptor for the atomic input snapshot the node fetches over its authenticated dataflow connection.

generation.description: Controller-keyed opaque snapshot generation; never a raw content digest.

object_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact private, keyed-blinded input publication.

metadataLimit.description: Maximum bytes buffered for any one TUF metadata document.

targetLimit.description: Maximum bytes streamed for any one release target.

timeouts.description: Every interval is bounded above: the two fields the node's report cadence rides on are capped at the freshness-derived maximum, and the rest at the 30-day contract ceiling.

checkIntervalSeconds.description: Steady-state check cadence. The node heartbeats at the bottom of this loop, so it is capped by the report freshness window rather than the generic ceiling.

refreshRetrySeconds.description: Check cadence after a retryable repository failure; same freshness-derived cap as `checkIntervalSeconds`.

healthGraceSeconds.description: Must be >= (healthSuccesses - 1) * healthIntervalSeconds, otherwise the health streak can never complete inside the grace window.
